text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After finishing our errands, we visited a 
clothing store, and—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Ah! Messiah-sa~n!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Waah~ Running into you is so lucky~! Out 
shopping with your Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Yes, clothes for the new season are 
hitting the shelves now, so I thought I 
might get something new if I find anything 
nice.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
So nice! Messiah-san, with your bright 
hair and eye color, you'd look great in 
both chic and vivid outfits!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Vivid clothes too... do you think so?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Hey, hey, Trainer, don't you think 
so too?
choice_data_list: Ah, yeah. I think it'd look good on you.
Y-Yeah. I think it looks good on you.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
It's a color I don't wear very often... 
But looking at it another way, wearing 
something like this might help me break 
through my shell a little...?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Vivlos-san, if you wouldn't mind, could 
you help me pick out some clothes?"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Huh, really!? Yayyyyyy♡ Well then, let's 
head down to the lower floor♪"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
For such a large space, there are so few 
items on display... Is this what people 
call "fashionable"...?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I gave the clothes we picked to the clerk♪ 
Let's hurry over to the fitting room!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Well? Were you able to put it on?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Please wait just a moment longer. ...Where 
do my arms go through...? What on earth is 
this ribbon for?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
That's off-the-shoulder, so you can just 
put it straight on! Just tie the ribbon 
behind your neck and you're good to go!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Put it on as is, and the ribbon goes in 
the back... I-Is this right?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me~! Yep, it fits perfectly! 
Eeeek~~~~!! It suits you so super well 
after all♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Look, look, Trainer! Messiah-san is just 
super cuteâ¡
choice_data_list:
Ah... Messiah, could you open the 
curtains?

Yeah... Messiah, can you open the 
curtains?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"H-Hold on a second, please. ...Um, I 
think you should put something on... 
otherwise you might catch a cold..."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll go grab a cardigan! What color 
would you like?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... If it's this color, would 
shades of gray go well with it?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Got it! Anything else? Just say the word!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
In that case, could you choose something 
that doesn't expose the shoulders too 
much? And with a thicker fabric for the 
skirt, if possible?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Sure! Leave it to me♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And so, swapping outfits and continuing 
to try on clothes for an entire hour—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Air Messiah bought a gray cardigan, a 
lemon-yellow blouse, and a simple brown 
skirt.
choice_data_list:
(I managed to finish shopping safely, 
but...)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"...I know it myself. In the end, it's 
just the same as always; I can't break out 
of my shell. I always end up settling on 
plain clothes like these..."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Mhm-mhm, it looked super good on you♪

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
However, looking at the clothes alone, the 
one Vivlos-san chose is far more 
glamorous...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
“It's the kind of clothes I like, though! 
Wearing something sensible, mature, and 
dependable is just way better—”

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: That feels super like you, Me-chan-senpai♡

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Geez... That is why I asked you to refrain 
from calling me that.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
However, thank you. Hearing you say that, 
Vivlos-san, makes my heart feel lighter.
choice_data_list:
I think Messiah looks lovely in an outfit 
like that too

I think you look lovely in clothes like 
that, too, Messiah.

The clothes you want to wear are the ones 
that suit you best, don't you think?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
However, thank you. Hearing you say that, 
Vivlos-san, makes my heart feel lighter.
choice_data_list:
I think Messiah looks lovely in an outfit 
like that too

I think you look lovely in clothes like 
that, too, Messiah.

The clothes you want to wear are the ones 
that suit you best, don't you think?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Even you, Trainer...! Fufu, maybe that's 
just how it goes sometimes.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I hope to break through in some way 
eventually, but for now, I want to accept 
that things are fine as they are.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps that might be so. No matter how 
wonderful the clothes themselves are—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
If you worry so much about what others 
think that you look down, it'll ruin 
everything.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"I think so too~! Clothes that make you 
happy just by wearing them are the best♡"
